info.title: Kids Coding Platform API
info.description: One API for the student and parent web app, the admin panel, the marketing site and the Flutter app. Every route checks the caller’s role.

type.description:
badge_earned, certificate_issued, payment_receipt, payment_failed, plan_ended,
trial_ending, child_shipped or child_certificate.

data.description: Keys and IDs the message needs, e.g. { "badgeKey": "first-ship" }.

token.description: The phone's Firebase Cloud Messaging token.

language.description: The app's language (en, ar or ur): notifications are written in it.

status.description: Always "ok" while the process is running.

email.description: The parent's email address. It becomes their login.

password.description: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.

displayName.description: How we greet the parent. Never shown publicly.

languageCode.description: Language for emails and the app, e.g. "en", "ar", "ur".

acceptTerms.description: Must be true: the parent accepts the terms and privacy policy.

status.description: Always "accepted". The response is the same whether or not the email is registered.

token.description: The token from the email link.
The token from the email link.

tokenDelivery.description:
How to hand over the refresh token. Browsers use "cookie" (the default): an
httpOnly cookie scripts can't read. The mobile app uses "body" and keeps it in
secure storage.

app.description:
Which app is signing in. The admin panel keeps its own refresh cookie, so a
staff session and a parent session in the same browser never overwrite each
other, and only staff can sign in to it. The mobile app is for students and
parents only, and always gets its refresh token in the body.

twoFactorEnabled.description: Whether two-factor login is switched on (staff only).

mustAcceptTerms.description: Parents: the terms changed since they last accepted them (ask before going on).

student.description: Students only: what other children see.

rules.description:
The caller's permission rules in CASL format, so apps can hide what the API
would refuse anyway. The API always re-checks.

status.description:
authenticated = signed in. mfa_required = send the authenticator code to
/v1/auth/mfa/verify. mfa_setup_required = staff account without two-factor yet:
call /v1/auth/mfa/setup, then /v1/auth/mfa/verify.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

mfaToken.description: Short-lived token for the two-factor step.

username.description: The login name the parent received, e.g. "swift-falcon-4821".

tokenDelivery.description:
How to hand over the refresh token. Browsers use "cookie" (the default): an
httpOnly cookie scripts can't read. The mobile app uses "body" and keeps it in
secure storage.

app.description:
Which app is signing in. The admin panel keeps its own refresh cookie, so a
staff session and a parent session in the same browser never overwrite each
other, and only staff can sign in to it. The mobile app is for students and
parents only, and always gets its refresh token in the body.

mfaToken.description: The short-lived token returned by login when a second step is needed.

secret.description: Base32 secret, for typing into an authenticator app by hand.

otpauthUrl.description: otpauth:// link; show it as a QR code.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the authenticator app.

tokenDelivery.description:
How to hand over the refresh token. Browsers use "cookie" (the default): an
httpOnly cookie scripts can't read. The mobile app uses "body" and keeps it in
secure storage.

app.description:
Which app is signing in. The admin panel keeps its own refresh cookie, so a
staff session and a parent session in the same browser never overwrite each
other, and only staff can sign in to it. The mobile app is for students and
parents only, and always gets its refresh token in the body.

refreshToken.description: Only for tokenDelivery "body" clients; browsers send the cookie instead.

tokenDelivery.description:
How to hand over the refresh token. Browsers use "cookie" (the default): an
httpOnly cookie scripts can't read. The mobile app uses "body" and keeps it in
secure storage.

app.description:
Which app is signing in. The admin panel keeps its own refresh cookie, so a
staff session and a parent session in the same browser never overwrite each
other, and only staff can sign in to it. The mobile app is for students and
parents only, and always gets its refresh token in the body.

version.description: The version the parent read (TERMS_VERSION), e.g. "2026-10".

displayName.description: Adults: their name. Students: their nickname.

reason.description: Why — kept in the audit log.

minXp.description: XP at which this level starts.

nextMinXp.description: XP at which the next level starts; null at the top level.

xp.description: XP earned today, in the student's time zone.

goalXp.description: The daily goal behind the streak.

capXp.description: Most XP that counts in one day.

current.description: Days in a row with the goal met (0 once a day is missed without a freeze).

freezes.description: Streak freezes held (each covers one missed day).

freezesNeeded.description: Freezes that meeting today's goal will use (days missed since the last goal).

key.description: ISO week, e.g. "2026-W40". Boards reset at Monday 00:00 in the student's time zone.

endDay.description: The next Monday, when the board resets.

hidden.description: True when the family keeps the student off public leaderboards.

regionRank.description: Null until the region's board is open (enough students) or no region is set.

endDay.description: The day after the last day; null while the end isn't planned.

season.description: The season staff are running, if any.

endDay.description: When the board resets (Monday 00:00, the student's time).

areaName.description: The region's or city's name, for those boards.

available.description:
False when there is nothing to show: no season running, no region or city set, or
fewer than `minStudents` students there on public boards.

seen.description: False for badges earned but not celebrated yet.

periodKey.description: The period shown, e.g. "2026-W40" (UTC week), a season ID or "all".

areaSize.description: Students on public boards there (region and city boards need `minStudents`).

endDay.description: Planned end: the day after the last day.

manual.description: True for badges staff give by hand (they can take these back).

amount.description: XP to take away (at most the student's total).

reason.description: Why, e.g. "Submitted copied answers in bulk". Kept in the audit log and XP history.

nativeName.description: Name in the language itself, e.g. "اردو"

publicLeaderboards.description: Show the child (nickname and avatar only) on city, country and global leaderboards.

publicPortfolio.description: Let anyone with the link see the child's finished projects.

premiumUntil.description: When today's premium ends (a plan renews on its own); null without premium.

premiumSource.description: Where premium comes from: the family's plan, our team, or the free trial.

trialEndsAt.description: The child's free trial (over or not).

streak.description: Days in a row with the daily goal met (0 once a day is missed).

streakReminders.description: Evening reminders in the mobile app when the streak is about to end.

birthYears.description: Birth years a parent may choose right now.

under13Open.description: Whether accounts for children under 13 are open.

nickname.description: Shown to other children. Letters, digits and _; never the child's real name.

birthYear.description: Only the year is stored, never the full date of birth.

languageCode.description: Language the child learns in, e.g. "ur".

password.description: Chosen by the parent; the child logs in with it.

streakReminders.description: Evening reminders on the child's phone when their streak is about to end.

allowed.description: True while "Public projects" is on: only then can the portfolio be shared.

token.description: The secret part of the share link, or null when there is no link.

py.description: Python lessons: the program (runs with Pyodide in the sandbox).

title.description: The project's title, in the requested language.

files.description: The shipped files, to show in the sandbox.

nickname.description: Type the child's nickname to confirm.

language.description: The language the texts are in (English when a translation is missing).

files.description: The editor tabs, in order: index.html, style.css, script.js.

checks.description: What the project needs before it can ship (see packages/checks).

hints.description: Hint texts by key, in the requested language with English filling gaps.

checkLabels.description: What each check looks at, by check ID, in the requested language (English fills gaps).

draft.description: The student's saved code, if any.

version.description: The portfolio version shipped last (1, 2, …), or null.

results.description: What the requirement checks in the browser sandbox found.

shipped.description: False when a requirement isn't met yet: nothing was published.

results.description: The result stored for each requirement.

xpAwarded.description: XP for shipping the first time (0 afterwards).

badgesEarned.description: Badges this earned (keys; names are translated in the apps), to celebrate.

unitMinor.description: One child, in minor units (paisa, piastres, fils, halalas).

extraUnitMinor.description: Each child after the first, with the family discount.

totalMinor.description: What the family pays per period.

source.description: Where premium comes from now: the family plan, staff, or the free trial.

provider.description: STRIPE = card; MANUAL = paid another way, recorded by our team.

amountMinor.description: One period for the whole family.

cancelAtPeriodEnd.description: Cancelled: premium stays until the period ends and the plan doesn't renew.

familyDiscountPercent.description: Each child after the first costs this much less.

checkoutAvailable.description: Families can buy a plan by card here (payments switched on, cards available).

subscription.description: The plan that gives premium now, or the latest one.

locale.description: The web app's language, for the page Stripe sends the family back to.

url.description: Stripe's checkout page (or the development mock's).

kind.description: first = the first child; extra = each other child, with the family discount.

paidWith.description: CARD or MANUAL; null when not paid.

manualMethod.description: Manual payments: how it was paid, e.g. "Bank transfer".

provider.description: STRIPE = card; MANUAL = paid another way, recorded by our team.

amountMinor.description: One period for the whole family.

cancelAtPeriodEnd.description: Cancelled: premium stays until the period ends and the plan doesn't renew.

stripeCustomerId.description: Stripe customer ID, to look the family up in Stripe's dashboard.

plans.description: What the family would pay now, per plan (for recording a manual payment).

periods.description: Months (monthly plan) or years (yearly plan) paid for.

amountMinor.description: What was received, in minor units. Defaults to the family's price × periods.

method.description: How the family paid, e.g. "Bank transfer" or "JazzCash".

reference.description: The bank's or wallet's reference, to find the payment again.

amountMinor.description: Minor units; defaults to everything not refunded yet.

immediately.description: true = premium stops now; false = at the end of the period.

prices.description: Per child, by plan key; null when not set yet.

monthlyMinor.description: Per child, by plan key, in minor units.

reason.description: Why, e.g. "Launch prices for Egypt". Kept in the audit log.

familyDiscountPercent.description: The smallest family discount across countries (each country has its own too).

openSafetyReports.description: "Something isn't safe" messages from families that aren't done yet.

recentActivity.description: The latest audit entries; empty for roles that can't read the audit log.

locked.description: Premium, and the student has no premium now (no trial, plan or grant).

quizCount.description: Quizzes the lesson has (short questions that work on a phone).

status.description: Always NOT_STARTED for accounts that aren't students.

locked.description: Premium, and the student has no premium now.

status.description: NOT_STARTED, DRAFT (saved but not shipped) or SHIPPED. Always NOT_STARTED for adults.

source.description: subscription (the family's plan), grant (given by our team) or trial.

nextLessonId.description: Where "Continue" goes: the first lesson the student hasn't completed.

premium.description: The student's premium (null for parents and staff, who can open everything).

checks.description: Checks for the browser sandbox (see packages/checks).

hints.description: Hint texts by key, in the requested language with English filling gaps.

checkLabels.description:
What each check looks at, by check ID ("The heading has a colour"), in the
requested language with English filling gaps: the checklist beside the editor.

draft.description: The student's saved code, if any.

passed.description: Whether the student has passed this challenge before.

text.description: Text in the student's language, or null when the option is code.

code.description: Code, shown as it is in every language, or null for a text option.

kind.description:
ORDER: put `lines` in order and send their IDs back. BUG: tap the line with the

codeLanguage.description: html, css, js or python: how to colour the code.

lines.description:
ORDER: the lines, shuffled. BUG, OUTPUT and CHOICE: the code as it is (the ID

solved.description: The student has answered it correctly before.

number.description: Position in the module, starting at 1.

language.description: The language the texts are in (English when a translation is missing).

quizzes.description: Short questions about the lesson (graded by the server).

results.description: What the checks in the browser sandbox found, one entry per check.

lessonCompleted.description: True when this submission completed the lesson (every challenge passed).

xpAwarded.description: XP this submission earned (challenge and, when completed, the lesson).

dailyCapReached.description: True when the daily XP cap held some of it back.

badgesEarned.description: Badges this earned (keys; names are translated in the apps), to celebrate.

order.description: ORDER: the line IDs in the student's order.

line.description: BUG: the number of the line with the mistake, from 1.

option.description: OUTPUT and CHOICE: the chosen option's ID.

explanation.description: Why the answer is right: shown once the quiz is answered correctly or revealed.

reveal.description: After a few wrong tries, the right answer, so the student can learn from it.

xpAwarded.description:
XP this answer earned: the quiz's on the first right answer (none once the
answer has been shown), and today's practice when this answer finished it.

practice.description: When the quiz is part of today's practice: how far along it is.

kind.description:
ORDER: put `lines` in order and send their IDs back. BUG: tap the line with the
mistake (send its number). OUTPUT: pick what the code shows. CHOICE: pick the
right answer.

codeLanguage.description: html, css, js or python: how to colour the code.

lines.description:
ORDER: the lines, shuffled. BUG, OUTPUT and CHOICE: the code as it is (the ID
is the line number). Empty when the quiz has no code.

solved.description: The student has answered it correctly before.

answeredQuizIds.description: Quizzes of today's practice already answered correctly today.

pagePath.description: The page it was sent from, e.g. "/ar/learn/builder-m01-l03" (query and fragment are dropped).

languageCode.description: The interface language when it was sent.

name.description: Adults: their name. Students: their nickname.

sender.description: Null when the account was deleted.

unread.description: Messages nobody has read yet (for the menu badge).

studentId.description: The student who has (or had) premium.

active.description: True while it gives premium: started, not ended, not revoked.

grants.description: Grants for this student, or for every child of this parent.

months.description: How long premium lasts from today.

reason.description: Why, e.g. "Pilot family from the Lahore school". Kept in the audit log.

signUps.description: Parents whose first child account was created that day.

firstProjects.description: Students who shipped their first project that day.

weeklyActive.description: Students with XP in the 7 days up to that day.

countries.description: Countries that have any numbers in the period.

rows.description: One row per day and country; days without activity are left out.

computedAt.description: When today's numbers were last worked out.

monthlySummary.description: The monthly email about the children's progress.

latest.description: The latest confirmed entries (to write to when a country opens).

moduleTitle.description: In the requested language (English when missing).

finished.description: Every lesson done and the module's project shipped.

premium.description: Whether the student has premium now (needed for a new certificate).

isActive.description: In content/ (the importer switches off what was removed).

publishedAt.description: When staff published it; null = students don't see it yet.

languages.description: Languages every lesson (and the project) is written in.

starter.description: The code students start from (html, css, js or py).

checks.description: What the checks look at, in words staff can read (e.g. "text of h1").

translated.description: False when this language has no text yet (English is shown instead).

isActive.description: Families in this country can sign up (and see its prices).

currency.description: ISO 4217, e.g. "PKR". Only while the country is switched off; prices are set again after.

accounts.description: Accounts using it (their emails and pages are in this language).

updatedBy.description: Who changed it last (staff name), if anyone has.

countryCodes.description: Only these countries; an empty list = every country.

fatal.description: The app had to stop (not just an error it recovered from).

stack.description: The stack trace; longer ones are cut.

lastWeek.description: Reports per app version over the last 7 days, most first.
